assets.alt: A row of stone stelae, each standing on the back of a carved stone turtle, under trees at the Temple of Literature.
A stele pavilion at the Temple of Literature: a tiled roof over whitewashed walls, with a stone stele on a carved turtle inside and inscribed panels on either side.
Scene illustrations are described in each scene.
